_description: Saturn's tier table — GENERATED by tools/pipeline/build-body-tiers.js --write (plan 27 step F). The map is the same throughout; `rings` says whether the ring mesh is shown at the TT age of the epoch (ages in Myr before J2000). The rings' age is a measured BAND (see sources.literature); the boundary is the pollution bound's upper edge. The gate tools/verify/surface-tiers.js checks the files against `files`.

literature.kempf2023: Kempf, S., Altobelli, N., Schmidt, J., Cuzzi, J.N., Estrada, P.R. & Srama, R., 2023. Micrometeoroid infall onto Saturn's rings constrains their age to no more than a few hundred million years. Science Advances 9, eadf8537 — ≤ ~400 Myr.
literature.iess2019: Iess, L. et al., 2019. Measurement and implications of Saturn's gravity field and ring mass. Science 364, eaat2965 — 10–100 Myr from the ring mass.
literature.hyodo2024: Hyodo, R., Genda, H. & Madeira, G., 2024. Saturn's rings may be older than they look (the pollution clock allows old rings). Nature Geoscience — the dissent; the age stays a band.

tiers.label: before its rings — their age is a band, ≤ 400 Myr (Kempf 2023) and disputed
